pretreatments.description: Thermal LHW (Lignin-Hydroxyl-Water) pretreatment conducted at 121 °C for 60 min using steam sterilization, performed with or without surfactant (PEG 6000, Triton X-100, or Tween 80) and with varying ethanol concentrations (60%) and solid-to-liquid ratios (1:10).

Dilute acid pretreatment using 1% H2SO4 conducted with or without surfactant (PEG 6000, Triton X-100, or Tween 80) at temperatures ranging from 50 °C to 37 °C in batch reactors, varying solid-to-liquid ratios (1:10), pH levels (4.8-4.5), and incubation times (72 hours).
Dilute alkali pretreatment using 0.5% NaOH conducted in steam sterilization at 121 °C for 60 min, performed with or without surfactant (PEG 6000, Triton X-100, or Tween 80).

Organosolve pretreatment using ethanol as the organic solvent conducted with or without surfactant (PEG 6000, Triton X-100, or Tween 80) and varying ethanol concentrations (60%) and solid-to-liquid ratios (1:10).
